prompt_text: I was in a car accident in Pleasanton CA. Which lawyer should I hire for my injury case?
ai_overview_text:
You can consult local personal injury professionals such as the Law Offices of Stephen M. Fuerch or Venardi Zurada LLP for your car accident case in Pleasanton.
Experience: Over 35 years of personal injury experience, including 25 years working in insurance defense, which provides insight into how insurers evaluate claims.
Fee Structure: Free initial consultations; contingency-fee basis (no fees unless there is a recovery).
Contact: Phone: (925) 463-2575
Contingency Fees: Most car accident attorneys in California operate on a contingency-fee model, typically taking between 33% and 40% of the final settlement or court award only if they successfully recover funds for you. Novian & Novian, LLP +1
Statute of Limitations: Under California Code of Civil Procedure § 335.1, you generally have two years from the date of the accident to file a personal injury lawsuit. Ben Crump - Trial Lawyer for Justice
Local Court Venue: Civil claims for Pleasanton are typically handled through the Alameda County judicial system, which utilizes the Gale-Schenone Hall of Justice for East County matters. Mirador Law
